information: ## Welcome to the Selangor Cube Open 2026 [![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/SelangorCubeOpen2026) **If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Information & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SelangorCubeOpen2026#76674-information-announcements). All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.** • Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information. • ***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
